name: PF1e Equipment
note: M16's equipment/armor/shield tables as the repo can honestly ship them: every row mirrors a table the resolver already reads in weapons.ts/items.ts/rulesTables.ts and names the appendix section it came from. Per-item prices, weights and the CRB equipment lists are deliberately absent — not transcribed in this repo's corpus (DEVIATIONS), and inventing them is what D-1 forbids. tests/packages/pf1eContentPacks.test.ts pins every row against the code table.

system.srd: AoN Rules ID 131 — verified Small 1d2, Medium 1d3, Large 1d4; the rest from the SRD unarmed-strike table (D-163, which also fixed this repo's wrong Medium 1d2).
system.notes: Mirrored from weapons.ts's UNARMED_STRIKE_DAMAGE_BY_SIZE, the table the resolver reads; tests/packages/pf1eContentPacks.test.ts fails if mirror and table part company. The pack carries no per-item prices or weights: the Core Rulebook's equipment tables are not transcribed in this repo's corpus, and DEVIATIONS records that rather than inventing a gold piece value.

data.name: Maximum Range Increments by Weapon Class

system.srd: §2.8/§2.9 — one rule for every weapon, refused before an attack is counted or a die consumed.
system.notes: Mirrored from weapons.ts's MAX_RANGE_INCREMENTS and ADVANCED_FIREARM_MAX_INCREMENTS.

system.srd: §2.9 — inside the window a firearm shot resolves against touch AC; outside it, against normal AC.
AoN Rules ID 413 (armor/shield) and §2.9b (broken weapon −2 attack / −2 damage).
system.notes: The item-state arithmetic items.ts's brokenArmorAdjustments and weapons.ts's brokenWeaponAdjustments apply. No spell-failure change is listed for broken items, so none is applied.

system.maxDexBonusByCategory: not a category rule in PF1e — each authored armor carries its own, and items.ts's resolvePF1eArmor reads it from the item
system.srd: Gap List §6/P5's armor row list (AC bonus, max Dex, ACP, ASF, weight). Of those, only ASF and the speed reduction are category-level rules, and those are what this row carries.
system.notes: Cross-check for the arcaneSpellFailureForCategory/armorReducesSpeed helpers in rulesTables.ts: a pack that ships a medium armor with a 5% failure chance fails the build.
